Reported cases of rubella and congenital rubella syndrome (CRS)
During 2004–2012, 79 cases of rubella and six cases of CRS were reported in the United States
This report describes three infants with CRS born in the United States in 2012
National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System, United States, 2004–2012
